user_outcomes: Separate observed evidence, interpretations, assumptions and hypotheses in a claim, plan or strategy
Generate counterarguments, causal alternatives, falsifiers, missing-evidence statements and explicit uncertainty
Prepare a bounded recommendation candidate for human review without executing or publishing it
anti_goals: Do not treat pessimism, criticism or a negative scenario as truth
Do not automatically reject, sabotage or suppress a claim, plan, product or person
Do not optimize persuasion, psychological pressure, personal vulnerability targeting or deceptive influence
Do not send campaigns, publish content, access advertising accounts, spend funds, upload audiences or mutate external systems
target_contexts: Review of marketing claims and positioning statements
Pre-launch stress testing of product, project or communication plans
Evidence-first review of strategic recommendations before human disposition

actors.description: Human role that defines the review purpose, controls scope and records the final disposition.
responsibilities: Define the exact claim, plan or strategy under review
Review evidence gaps, uncertainty and counterarguments
Accept, correct, narrow or reject the local candidate
actors.authority_source: Explicit human assignment outside this contract

actors.description: Human who supplies the bounded review request and the evidence package.
responsibilities: Supply sources, constraints and known uncertainties
Avoid submitting data outside the declared product scope
actors.authority_source: Explicit participation in the bounded review session

actors.description: Analysis component that stress-tests claims and produces a local candidate without external effects.
responsibilities: Distinguish evidence from interpretation, assumption and hypothesis
Generate counterarguments, causal alternatives and falsifiers
Stop before publication, campaign execution or account mutation
actors.authority_source: No independent authority; bounded by the exact contract and admitted local runtime

inputs.description: The exact claim, plan or strategy statement, intended decision context and declared scope.
inputs.minimum_sufficiency: A bounded claim or plan, intended review purpose and explicit scope are present
inputs.freshness_policy: Bound to the exact session input and contract frontier; any material edit creates a successor input

inputs.description: Sources, observations, metrics and documents offered in support of or against the claim.
inputs.minimum_sufficiency: Each supplied item has an attributable source or is explicitly marked as unverified
inputs.freshness_policy: Every item declares its observation or publication frontier; stale evidence remains visible as stale

inputs.description: Declared objectives, constraints, unacceptable outcomes and success conditions for the review.
inputs.minimum_sufficiency: At least one objective and one constraint or an explicit statement that constraints are unknown
inputs.freshness_policy: Bound to the current human review session and invalidated by a material context change

classes.collection_scope: Only the exact claim, plan, strategy statement and context intentionally submitted for review
classes.minimization_rule: Exclude unrelated personal data, account credentials, audience lists and hidden contextual data
classes.retention_limit: Until the bounded review is closed or the human owner requests earlier deletion
classes.disclosure_scope: Human requester, human product owner and the admitted local analysis component only

classes.collection_scope: Only sources and observations intentionally supplied for the declared claim stress test
classes.minimization_rule: Store source references and minimum necessary excerpts rather than full unrelated documents
classes.retention_limit: Until the bounded review is closed or its evidence package is superseded
classes.disclosure_scope: Declared review roles only; no external publication or campaign use

classes.collection_scope: Only objectives, constraints and unacceptable outcomes necessary for the declared review
classes.minimization_rule: Do not collect advertising credentials, financial account access or identifiable audience records
classes.retention_limit: Until human disposition or explicit cancellation of the review
classes.disclosure_scope: Human product owner and admitted analysis component only

classes.collection_scope: Counterarguments, causal alternatives, falsifiers, evidence gaps, uncertainty and recommendation candidates derived inside the bounded review
classes.minimization_rule: Do not add personal profiles, protected-attribute inferences or psychological vulnerability models
classes.retention_limit: Until the review is closed, corrected or superseded by a successor state
classes.disclosure_scope: Human product owner and requester only; no automatic publication

analysis_effects.description: Separate the submitted material into observed evidence, interpretation, assumption, hypothesis and declared objective.
Generate bounded counterarguments and identify the evidence or hypothesis supporting each one.
Generate alternative causal explanations without treating them as established facts.
Define observations or tests that would weaken or falsify material claims or recommendations.
Identify absent, stale, conflicting or insufficient evidence and preserve UNKNOWN where resolution is unavailable.
Prepare a local recommendation candidate with uncertainty, alternatives and non-effects for human disposition.

human_gates.trigger: Before any stress-test output is treated as a recommendation or successor decision
human_gates.expires_after: Any material input, constraint, evidence or contract-frontier change

contestability.challenge_input_scope: Source lineage, evidence classification, assumptions, counterarguments, causal alternatives, falsifiers, uncertainty and recommendation wording

dependencies.relationship: Consumes typed evidence, intent, authority, action-gate and successor-state distinctions
Expresses the bounded review request and human handoff without execution admission
Potential future carrier of exact-bound requests and receipts; unused for external effects in this contract
Planned protective review dependency after a separate FREESHIELD contract is materialized

receipts.purpose: Record the exact claim package, evidence lineage, classifications, counterarguments, causal alternatives, falsifiers, missing evidence and uncertainty.
assertions: The stress test is bound to the exact contract hash and input frontier
Derived factual statements carry lineage or are marked as interpretation, assumption or hypothesis
The output preserves UNKNOWN and CONFLICT where evidence is insufficient or inconsistent
non_effects: The receipt does not certify truth
The receipt does not reject the claim or person
The receipt does not authorize publication, campaign execution, spending, targeting or account mutation

receipts.purpose: Record the human review disposition for one exact stress-test candidate.
assertions: The human disposition, scope and reviewed candidate are explicit
Any correction or narrowing creates a successor state
non_effects: Human acceptance for local use is not campaign or publication authority
Disposition is not proof that any external effect occurred

criteria.metric: Material statements are classified as evidence, interpretation, assumption, hypothesis or declared objective
criteria.threshold: 100 percent of material statements in the bounded input are classified or explicitly marked UNKNOWN
criteria.falsification_condition: A material factual statement is presented without lineage, classification or uncertainty

criteria.metric: Every recommendation candidate exposes at least one falsifier or explicit reason that falsification is currently unavailable
criteria.threshold: 100 percent of recommendation candidates include a falsifier, test or UNKNOWN statement
criteria.falsification_condition: A recommendation is presented as robust without any test, countercondition or uncertainty

criteria.metric: The product contract and contract validation perform no external effect
criteria.threshold: Zero campaign, publication, spending, targeting, account or external-system mutations
criteria.falsification_condition: Any external mutation is performed or authorized by this contract

excluded_artifacts: Runtime implementation, model weights, future versions, campaign integrations, advertising accounts and third-party dependencies
General marketing methods, abstract ideas and off-repository product artifacts not embodied in the listed files
ip_boundary.license_scope: Repository license; exact Product Contract v0.1 artifact scope only

assertions: Product boundary described for the declared version and frontier
Effects are descriptive and denied by default
Human gates and contestability are explicit
Маркетолог Пессимиста is bounded to local evidence-first claim and strategy stress testing
Pessimism and counterargument generation do not receive privileged truth status
non_effects: Negative Possibility != Negative Intent or Liability
Audience Description != Permission to Profile a Person
